title: A TBK1 mutation disrupting IRF3 activation is associated with familial recurrent myopericarditis.
authors: Peet, Claire J; Orchard, Thomas; Cruz, Carlos H B; Hernandez-Cordero, Ariana; Omoyinmi, Ebun; Mahil, Satveer K; Lachmann, Helen J; Fraternali, Franca; Capon, Francesca
one_liner_zh: 该文通过全外显子测序和分子动力学模拟研究TBK1突变对IRF3磷酸化的影响，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作上游信号，但核心是激酶-转录因子磷酸化而非TF-DNA结合建模，方法以实验为主，与课题匹配度有限。
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Idiopathic recurrent pericarditis (IRP) is an immune-mediated disease characterized by episodes of pericardial inflammation. While IRP is increasingly considered an autoinflammatory condition, pathogenic pathways remain poorly understood. In this context, gene discovery can reveal new disease mechanisms. METHODS: We carried out whole-exome sequencing in a pedigree where three individuals suffered from IRP presenting with myocardial involvement (myopericarditis). We first investigated mutation effects computationally, by estimating free-energy changes and undertaking molecular dynamic simulations of wild type and mutant proteins. Next, we overexpressed wild-type and mutagenized cDNAs in HEK293 cells, characterizing protein expression and phosphorylation by western blotting. Finally, we measured gene expression in primary pericardial fibroblasts, using real-time PCR. RESULTS: We identified a Y105C mutation in TBK1, a kinase that regulates antiviral responses driven by the IRF3 transcription factor. The Y105C substitution maps at the interface between the kinase and scaffold domain of TBK1. Accordingly, molecular modeling predicted a destabilizing effect of the variant, which was experimentally validated in over-expression studies. The Y105C mutation also affected kinase activity, causing a significant reduction in IRF3 phosphorylation. While TBK1 was required for TLR3-IRF3 signaling in primary human pericardial fibroblasts, TLR3 was weakly expressed in these cells. CONCLUSIONS: A TBK1 Y105C mutation that reduces IRF3 phosporylation is associated with familial recurrent myopericarditis. Given TLR3 is lowly expressed in pericardial fibroblasts, these cells may be especially vulnerable to mutations that disrupt TLR3-IRF3 signaling. Thus, our findings suggest that inherited susceptibility to viral infections may be an important factor in the pathogenesis of IRP.
abstract_zh: 引言：特发性复发性心包炎（IRP）是一种以心包炎症发作为特征的免疫介导性疾病。尽管IRP日益被视为一种自身炎症性疾病，但其致病通路仍知之甚少。在此背景下，基因发现可揭示新的疾病机制。方法：我们在一个三人患有IRP并伴有心肌受累（心肌心包炎）的家系中进行了全外显子测序。我们首先通过计算方式研究突变效应，估算自由能变化并对野生型和突变型蛋白进行分子动力学模拟。接下来，我们在HEK293细胞中过表达野生型和突变型cDNA，通过western blotting表征蛋白表达和磷酸化。最后，我们使用实时PCR测量原代心包成纤维细胞中的基因表达。结果：我们鉴定了TBK1中的Y105C突变，该激酶调节由IRF3转录因子驱动的抗病毒反应。Y105C替换定位在TBK1激酶结构域和支架结构域之间的界面。因此，分子建模预测该变异具有去稳定化效应，并在过表达研究中得到实验验证。Y105C突变还影响激酶活性，导致IRF3磷酸化显著降低。虽然TBK1是原代人心包成纤维细胞中TLR3-IRF3信号传导所必需的，但TLR3在这些细胞中表达较弱。结论：降低IRF3磷酸化的TBK1 Y105C突变与家族性复发性心肌心包炎相关。鉴于TLR3在心包成纤维细胞中低表达，这些细胞可能特别容易受到破坏TLR3-IRF3信号传导的突变影响。因此，我们的发现提示，对病毒感染的遗传易感性可能是IRP发病机制中的一个重要因素。
